# AetherTrigger

> AetherTrigger is a development-stage business intelligence brand of Quant Data Intelligence LLC, focused on opportunity identification for B2B providers serving Shopify and Shopify Plus merchants.

Slogan: Turn aether signals into your next business opportunity. AetherTrigger is independent of Shopify. No live alerting, monitoring, subscription, API, or purchasable product is currently represented as available.
